title: Enhanced performance in low band gap polymer solar cells via surface lattice resonance of non-noble metals
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,20117-20130
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01628F, Paper
Open Access

Simenew A. Mulat, Fekadu G. Hone, Nika Bekri, Newayemedhin A. Tegegne
Thin-film organic solar cells (OSCs) have limited light absorption due to their thin active layers, constrained by short carrier diffusion lengths. Plasmonic nanoparticles enhance absorption by acting as nanoscale light sources, improving photon harvesting without increasing thickness.
